'''Galron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived with his twin daughters, [[Mari (Mandalorian)|Mari]] and [[Tayn]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3637 BBY]], he took his daughters on a hunting trip to [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], and told them bedtime stories about [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and [[Mandalore the Conqueror]].<ref name="Bedtime" />
